title: Novel Synthesis Method for Carboxylated CNCs
abstract: This paper details a new, efficient, and scalable method for producing highly carboxylated cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) with improved yield and dispersibility.

title: Cellulose Aerogels for Marine Oil Spill Remediation
abstract: Investigating the efficacy of novel Aeschynomene aspera based aerogels for rapid and high-capacity oil absorption in marine environments.

title: Biodegradable Packaging Materials from Nano Cellulose
abstract: Development of fully biodegradable packaging materials using cellulose nanofibers as a sustainable alternative to petroleum-based plastics.
